flags: CRITICAL DATE CORRECTION: the GST rate cut took effect 22 Sep 2025, NOT 22 Sep 2026 as stated in the task brief. Evidence: M&M statement of 6 Sep 2025 passing on GST 2.0 benefits early ('GST rates effective from September 22'); CNBC TV18 (Sep 2026) says 'GST cuts introduced last year still keep prices below pre-GST levels'. All GST-linked records above use the 2025 dates. The project memory/Phase-3 assumption of a 22 Sep 2026 GST cut appears wrong and should be re-verified across makers.

5-door Thar as separate nameplate; entry MX1 2.0L turbo-petrol MT Rs 12.99L (introductory), MX1 diesel MT Rs 13.99L; M&M exchange filing. Price reveal happened evening of Aug 14, 2024; official launch Aug 15, 2024.

Facelift launched alongside updated Bolero: new chrome-slatted grille, bumpers, 16in alloys, 9in touchscreen, dual-tone cabin, N11 new top variant; entry N4 Rs 8.49L, top N11 Rs 9.99L; priced Rs 25-50k below outgoing per Autocar. Electric derivative of XUV 3XO replacing XUV400; 39.4kWh battery; AX5 Rs 13.89L, AX7L Rs 14.96L ex-showroom; deliveries from Feb 23, 2026.
Facelift: panoramic sunroof, 12.3in touchscreen, 10.25in digital cluster, 540-degree camera; entry Z2 petrol MT Rs 13.69L (up Rs 20k vs outgoing). Media describe exterior changes as minor.

Marketed as Thar OG: new M_Glyde 4G platform (from Thar Roxx), EPS, Pentalink rear + Watts link, stronger engines, 6 airbags; replaces 2020 Thar; entry AXT D117 diesel RWD MT Rs 10.32L (introductory to Nov 30, 2026). Could arguably be a New generation.

model_notes.note: GST 2.0: Mahindra passed full GST benefits early from 6 Sep 2025 (official GST rate date 22 Sep 2025) — Thar RWD diesel cut up to Rs 1.35L, Thar 4WD diesel up to Rs 1.01L. Separately, Mahindra announced an up-to-3% price hike across its SUV range effective Jan 2025.
